nom: Perricone MD Vitamin C Ester Brightening Serum

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report the serum is gentle and non-irritating, in one case helping clear lingering jawline breakouts without the small bumps they get from other vitamin C serums, though one reviewer warns strongly against use on sensitive or actively acne-prone skin after a severe reaction.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry, flaky, eczema-prone skin reports seeing results within a few days of adding this serum to her routine.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin consistently describe the serum as light and non-greasy, with several noting their skin feels less oily since starting it, though one with oily combination skin found it dried her skin out with daily use.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin generally report smoother, more even-toned skin, though one reports the serum dried her skin out when used daily.
segments.normal: Reviewers with normal skin report mixed outcomes: one developed red bumps across her face and neck that resolved only after she stopped use, while others describe brighter, fast-absorbing results with no irritation, though one reviewer's stubborn sunspot did not lighten.
segments.mature: A few reviewers in their 50s or with years of continued use report the serum leaves their skin looking noticeably brighter and healthier, though one 55-year-old reviewer's stubborn sunspot and existing fine lines did not visibly change.

concerns.aging: Reports on fine lines and wrinkles are mixed: reviewers aged 35 and 55 report no noticeable change despite weeks of consistent use, while others describe fewer visible fine lines, a tighter or more youthful look, and one reports wrinkle-free skin after two years of using this serum alongside other anti-aging products in the same line.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the serum absorbs quickly without drying or irritating their skin; a few, however, including one with oily combination skin who used it daily and one who notes the formula contains alcohol, report it left their skin feeling dried out.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report the serum caused redness, itching, or hive-like bumps, which subsided only after they stopped using it; others, by contrast, report reduced redness — including shorter-lived redness around individual blemishes — or no redness or irritation at all compared with other vitamin C products they had tried.
concerns.spots: The majority of reviewers report visible fading of dark spots, hyperpigmentation, melasma, age spots, or acne scars, in some cases within days to a few weeks of use; a couple of reviewers, however, report no improvement — including one long-standing sunspot that did not lighten despite continued use, and one who felt it did not even out her tone at all.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin report fewer breakouts, clearer skin, or blackheads clearing with regular use, and several say it is the only vitamin C product that has not caused them to break out; a few reviewers, however, report the opposite — new pimples, itchy bumps, or a reaction strong enough that they stopped using it, particularly on active breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin consistently describe the serum as light and non-greasy, and several report their skin looking or feeling less oily since they started using it.

aspects.libelle: Doesn't absorb well for some, flakes on skin
Strong medicinal scent bothers some users
Small amount goes a long way

extraits.titre: Do not use if your skin is sensitive or acne prone
extraits.texte: Bought this during Ulta's 21 days of beauty and super thankful I didn't pay full price. It made my face explode with bumps and pimples. My face felt so irritated. I decided to try it one more day and will never use again. I typically take reviews from folks with acne with a grain of salt. Often times people treating acne mix AHA/BHA products with this serum and have a reaction. That was not my case, I made sure it wasn't mixed with salicylic/benzoyl peroxide because I knew they wouldn't mix well. Still had a terrible reaction. Don't use if you've got super sensitive or acne prone skin with active breakouts!

extraits.titre: Red bumps not working for me
extraits.texte: I love the scent of this product being very ginger and earthy and I don't have sensitive skin, but this product after 2 days I started getting small red bumps all over my face and neck. I stopped using and bumps went away. I tried one more time on my upper chest skin and got same red bumps. I would not reccomend this product if you have sensitive skin, or even dry skin. I have normal skin and never had issues until I tried this product. Once I stopped I was fine??

I bought this line (brightening) along with the Cold Plasma when there was a sale going on. I was not impressed with either. While this one does not break me out like the other, I'm not seeing any benefits and it's been a few months now. I will say a little bit goes a long way. The part that is annoying is I don't want to waste this, so while I would like to move onto another brand to help my skincare issues (35 years old, face looks dull and fine lines - so brightening and anti-aging), I cannot justify not using this since it's not technically hurting my face. I would like it to run out already so I can try another brand. lol I pretty much wasted a lot of money on Perricone MD products. Not impressed at all, and side note, I am a product junkie, so I have ample experience judging results from products from drug store brands to the prestige brands to pricy department store brands.

I like this product but I didn't love it. I have oily combination skin and yet if I used it daily it dried my skin out. Maybe I should have only used every other day. I received the product free from Influenster for testing. The bottle lasts a long time despite being small.

I'm 55 years old and I have normal skin with some lines and wrinkles. Not many. I also have a sun spot that I have been battling. I like to use this product at once a day along with my moisturizer. While this has brightened my skin, I am still at war with my sun spot. I was hoping this would lighten it, but it has not. I have used other PerriconeMD products and have been very pleased. I received this product for free for testing and to review.

This Vitamin-C serum is milky and absorbs well. I have very oily skin and this product melts into my skin and does not feel greasy. It does have an orange smell that goes away quickly. It's expensive but worth it!

This product will not change your skin overnight. It takes consistent use but the results are absolutely worth it. I use it (mostly) in the morning and night. In the winter I won't use toner and I'll go straight to this. Both myself and my partner have benefited from this amazing serum. It is kind of pricey which has made me think of reconsidering this product. Other products I use: vitamin c face wash, and spf moisturizer by perricone I have sensitive skin^ and tend to break out along my jawline. This product actually helped clear any lingering blackheads!
